steps.title: Gallery List Screen, Gallery Detail Screen, Search and Filter Functionality

items.title: Gallery List Screen
items.description: Display a list of galleries with title, photographer, and selection progress.

covers.text: Compact product header and primary navigation.
Gallery title, photographer, and selection progress.
Return to Gallery and confirm search remains.
Bundled sample data and browser storage.
No backend, authentication provider, external API, or real submission.
Client is already signed in as a demo user.
Changes persist after page reload in the same browser.
Use the existing starter, component library, and dependencies. Add no packages.
No network connection necessary for the core workflow after the app and bundled assets have loaded.
Client must choose exactly five photos before submitting.

tests.behaviour: open the gallery list screen
search for 'Window Light'
tests.expect: Window Light and Last Light photos are shown

items.title: Gallery Detail Screen
items.description: Show detailed information about a gallery including its photos and selection status.

covers.text: light returns Window Light and Last Light, not Golden Hour.
No-results state offers a clear way to clear search.

tests.behaviour: open a gallery detail screen
select 5 photos and submit

items.title: Search and Filter Functionality
items.description: Implement a search bar and category filter that work together to display relevant photo records.

covers.text: Search and category filtering work together.
Confirm Window Light is the only result.
Open it and confirm title, category, and image match.

tests.behaviour: type 'Outdoor' in search bar
select 'Indoor' from category dropdown
clear search and select 'Outdoor'

steps.title: R5 — Shortlist behavior: Photo Shortlisting with Selection Count and 3 more

items.title: Photo Shortlisting with Selection Count
items.description: Allow users to select up to five photos for their shortlist, with real-time count updates.

covers.text: Attempting to add a sixth does not remove or replace an existing selection.
Removing a photo permits another to be added.
Save locally without a separate Save button.
Notes remain attached when a photo is removed from the shortlist.
Reopening a photo restores its note.
Submission includes notes for selected photos only.
Reloading after submission must not unlock selection.
Switching photos must not carry one photo’s note into another.

tests.behaviour: select 5 photos from gallery list
try to select a sixth photo
tests.expect: no change in selection or error message

tests.behaviour: remove one photo from selection

items.title: Navigation and Identity
items.description: Ensure direct navigation to photo records works correctly with browser back/forward functionality.

covers.text: Directly opening a valid photo route displays that record.
Photo opened from grid is the same record displayed in detail.

tests.behaviour: navigate directly to photo detail URL
click browser back button
open photo from grid, then switch to another
tests.expect: no note carried over between photos

items.title: Gallery Selection Replacement and Validation
items.description: Allow users to remove and replace photos in a gallery while maintaining correct selection counts.

tests.behaviour: verify selection count changes everywhere
tests.expect: Count updates across all relevant screens

items.title: Gallery Submission and Locking
items.description: Enable users to submit a gallery for review, locking the selection and notes from further changes.

covers.text: With fewer than five, confirm submission cannot proceed.
Open submission dialog, cancel, and confirm nothing changes.
Verify Submitted status, timestamp, and correct five photos.
Verify shortlist and note editing are locked across screens.
Reload and confirm submitted state remains locked.
Open Start over and cancel; confirm all submitted data remains.
Open Start over again and confirm.
Verify empty Draft selection and cleared notes.

tests.behaviour: attempt to submit with fewer than five photos
select exactly five photos and submit
tests.expect: Submitted status, timestamp, and correct five photos displayed
